environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with the default Python sqlite3 module. No request validation middleware.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no TLS termination at LB
